content:
### 1. LAYOUT
*   **Window:** 1024x768 (Maximized). Standard Windows 11 chrome (Title bar + Taskbar).
*   **Sidebar (Left):** [0, 60] to [275, 940]. Contains navigation groups.
    *   **Data Recovery Group:** [0, 95] to [275, 320].
    *   **Advanced Features Group:** [0, 365] to [275, 525].
    *   **File Backup Group:** [0, 565] to [275, 655].
*   **Main Content Area (Right):** [285, 60] to [995, 940]. White background card with rounded corners.
    *   **Header:** [310, 110] to [680, 150]. Title and refresh icon.
    *   **Section: Internal Drives:** [310, 195] to [845, 345]. Grid of 2 tiles.
    *   **Section: Specify a Location:** [310, 400] to [575, 550]. Grid of 2 tiles.
    *   **Selection Card:** [310, 600] to [575, 725]. Large selected tile.
    *   **Footer Area:** [310, 860] to [975, 905]. Helper text (left) and CTA button (right).
*   **Taskbar (Bottom):** [0, 940] to [1024, 768].

### 2. TEXT
*   **Title Bar:** "EaseUS Data Recovery Wizard Free"
*   **Sidebar Headers:**
    *   "Data Recovery"
    *   "Advanced Features"
    *   "File Backup"
*   **Sidebar Items:**
    *   "Hardware Disk"
    *   "SD Card"
    *   "More Recovery Tools"
    *   "File Repair"
    *   "Lost Partition Rescue"
    *   "ChronoSnap Backup"
*   **Main Header:** "Select a location to search for lost data"
*   **Subheader:** "Internal drives (2)"
*   **Tile 1:** "Windows(C:)" / "31.34 GB/149.45 GB"
*   **Tile 2:** "Temporary Storage(D:)" / "146.12 GB/150 GB"
*   **Subheader 2:** "Specify a location"
*   **Tile 3:** "Recycle Bin"
*   **Tile 4:** "Desktop"
*   **Tile 5 (Selected):** "Select Folder"
*   **Footer Text:** "Unable to find your hard drive?"
*   **Button:** "Search for Lost Data"
*   **System Tray Time:** "7:59 PM" / "10/17/2026"

### 3. COLOR
*   **Backgrounds:**
    *   Window Client Area: `#F5F8FC` (Light Blue-Grey) - ESTIMATED
    *   Main Content Panel: `#FFFFFF` (White) - ESTIMATED
    *   Sidebar Selection: `#E8F0FE` (Light Blue) - ESTIMATED
*   **Text:**
    *   Primary (Headers/Titles): `#1F1F1F` (Near Black) - ESTIMATED
    *   Secondary (Captions/Subtext): `#666666` (Dark Grey) - ESTIMATED
    *   Sidebar Item Text: `#333333` - ESTIMATED
*   **Accents & States:**
    *   Primary Brand Blue (Button/Progress/Check): `#2D7FF9` (Vibrant Blue) - ESTIMATED
    *   Button Hover/Active State: Slightly darker blue gradient.
    *   Selected Tile Border: `#2D7FF9` - ESTIMATED
    *   Success Checkmark (Sidebar): `#34C759` (Green) - ESTIMATED

### 4. TYPOGRAPHY
*   **Window Title:** Segoe UI, ~11px, Regular.
*   **Main Heading ("Select a location..."):** Segoe UI Variable / Segoe UI, ~20px, Semibold.
*   **Section Headers ("Internal drives...", "Specify..."):** Segoe UI, ~14px, Regular, Grey.
*   **Tile Titles ("Windows(C:)", etc.):** Segoe UI, ~14px, Medium/Semibold.
*   **Tile Stats ("31.34 GB..."):** Segoe UI, ~11px, Regular, Grey.
*   **Sidebar Items:** Segoe UI, ~13px, Regular.
*   **CTA Button:** Segoe UI, ~14px, Semibold, White.

### 5. SPACING & SIZING
*   **Sidebar Width:** ~275px.
*   **Sidebar Item Height:** ~48px.
*   **Sidebar Icon Size:** 24x24px (rendered area), padded ~12px left.
*   **Main Content Padding:** ~30px from edge, ~40px between sections vertically.
*   **Tile Dimensions:** Width ~240px, Height ~100px (for drive tiles).
*   **Tile Icon Size:** 48x48px or 64x64px (large illustrative icons).
*   **Progress Bar Height:** ~4px or ~6px.
*   **CTA Button:** Height ~44px, Width ~200px, Border Radius ~6px.
*   **Selected Tile Border Radius:** ~8px, Stroke Width: ~1.5px or 2px.

### 6. CONTROLS & STATES
*   **Navigation List (Sidebar):**
    *   **Item: Hardware Disk:** State = **Selected** (Blue background, blue left accent strip implied by context, green check badge visible).
    *   **Item: SD Card:** State = Normal.
    *   **Item: More Recovery Tools:** State = Normal.
    *   **Item: File Repair:** State = Normal.
    *   **Item: Lost Partition Rescue:** State = Normal.
    *   **Item: ChronoSnap Backup:** State = Normal.
*   **Location Tiles (Main):**
    *   **Windows(C:)**: State = Normal (Hover possible, but looks default). Contains Progress Bar.
    *   **Temporary Storage(D:)**: State = Normal. Contains Progress Bar.
    *   **Recycle Bin**: State = Normal.
    *   **Desktop**: State = Normal.
    *   **Select Folder**: State = **Selected/Focused** (Blue border, Blue checkmark icon in top-right corner).
*   **Buttons:**
    *   **Search for Lost Data:** State = **Primary/Enabled** (Solid blue background, white text). Location: Bottom Right.
*   **Icons (Top Right):**
    *   Cloud/Avatar, Cart, Gift, Info, Menu (Hamburger), Minimize, Maximize/Restore, Close.

### 7. ICONOGRAPHY
*   **Style:** "Fluent Design" / Microsoft Modern style. Soft, rounded geometry.
*   **Types:**
    *   **Filled/Acrylic:** Drive icons (Windows logo on disk, generic disk), Folder icon.
    *   **Outline/Line:** Sidebar navigation icons (Disk, SD Card, Tools, Wrench, Partition arrow, Backup arrows).
    *   **Symbol:** Refresh (circular arrow), Checkmark (circle), Info (i in circle).

### 8. STATE
*   **Page State:** **Initial / Selection Pending**. The user is on the location selection step of the wizard. No scanning has started. The "Select Folder" option is currently the active selection.
*   **Motion Cues:** None visible (static screenshot). The refresh icon suggests an async capability to update drive list.
